sources.title: Synbit: Synthesizing Bidirectional Programs using Unidirectional Sketches
sources.snippet: We propose a technique for synthesizing bidirectional programs from the corresponding unidirectional code plus a few input/output examples. The core ideas are: (1) constructing a sketch using the given unidirectional program as a specification, and (2) filling the sketch in a modular fashion by exploiting the properties of bidirectional programs.
